parent_objective: run bounded four-wheel source viability calibration smoke
blocked_by: M1270 admits one bounded viability calibration smoke after M1268 collision dominance

public_gates: M1271 must preserve actor input contract
M1271 must not use private holdout
M1271 must preserve strict accepted-source thresholds
M1271 must preserve obstacle_completed or safe_stop success semantics
M1271 must report accepted rows, collision dominance, and source diversity
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add per-wheel/fault labels to actor inputs
do not count horizon-only rows as success
do not claim high-fidelity validation from the compact pilot
do not use policy success as a substitute for strict source acceptance

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether a calibrated four-wheel source grid restores own-branch viability while preserving high-regret action divergence
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: source-smoke infrastructure only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if observation mapping leaks per-wheel/fault metadata
stop if accepted thresholds are relaxed
stop if horizon-only rows are counted as success
stop for result audit before actor/history integration
fallback_plan: if accepted rows are zero, audit whether action support or model fidelity remains limiting
if accepted rows exist, audit source diversity and boundary suitability before any actor integration
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1270 admits one bounded calibrated source-smoke

admission_evidence: M1270 scratch calibration found accepted rows without threshold relaxation
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1271 tests source shape only and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until source-positive cases are audited
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If source-positive rows remain zero, write a source-smoke audit before any actor/Gym integration.
allowed_claims: four-wheel source viability calibration smoke result
no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: The calibrated four-wheel source grid can restore own-branch viability while preserving strict high-regret action divergence under unchanged source thresholds.
failure_criteria: horizon-only rows are counted as success

commands.name: focused_tests
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_four_wheel_fault_source_shape.py tests/test_four_wheel_dynamics.py

commands.name: smoke
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.four_wheel_fault_source_shape --scenario-profile viability_calibration --run-dir runs/m1271_four_wheel_source_viability_calibration_smoke

decision_rule: M1271 passes as infrastructure if it emits calibrated source-smoke artifacts with strict thresholds and guardrails, regardless of whether source-positive rows are found.
